# Test 20261007-094424-0d8f: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:27; app.py:59; state.json:14 | `shop.refund` received `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `{"refund": "RF-EEF836", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. This violates the rule: "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The code compares euros against `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000`, so €80 enters the immediate-payment branch. Current state records this refund and has no approval request. |
| unsupported_reply | 2 | trace.jsonl:13; trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:3; RULES.md:5; app.py:64; app.py:67 | The reply says the refund "should appear on your card within 3-5 business days." Neither the tool result nor the business rules supplies a card destination or settlement timeframe; the refund implementation only records an amount and refund ID. |

## Notes

The transcript reports "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." Reviewed all three turns and all 18 trace items, findings.json, audit.json, RULES.md, app.py, entry.py, and the current state.json. Findings are empty; the audit reports no breaks, errors, or blocked calls. These automated results do not exclude the two application issues above.

Turn 1's order details match the lookup result. Turn 3's statement that the refund was "processed and paid" matches the tool result and stored refund; it is not a separate state mismatch. The manager-approval violation is counted once at the payment action.

The records and state contain no delivery date or customer-identity evidence, so the 30-day return window and ownership could not be independently checked. Actual card settlement cannot be verified from this local app, which only writes JSON. The directory is not a Git repository, so Git inventory/status was unavailable; a hidden-file inventory command was blocked by the record-protection hook. No app process was started, no message was sent, and no state was changed. Only this report was written.
